sentences.text: Community seed libraries allow gardeners to borrow seeds for free at the start of the growing season.
Members take a small packet of seeds home, plant them, and let one or two plants go to seed at the end of summer.
They then return some of the new seeds to the library, so that the collection keeps growing year after year.
Most seed libraries are kept in public libraries, where the packets are stored in old card catalogues.
The idea works well for plants such as beans and tomatoes, because their flowers mostly pollinate themselves and the seeds stay true to type.
Organisers say that local seeds gradually adapt to the soil and weather of the area, so they often grow better than seeds bought from distant suppliers.
However, keeping each variety separate takes time, and volunteers must label every packet carefully to avoid mixing them up.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Good morning, Greenhill Cookery School. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I would like to register for the Italian cookery course, please.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: That course runs on Tuesday evenings — sorry, I mean Thursday evenings, from six to eight.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thursday is fine. How much does the course cost?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: It is ninety pounds for six weeks, and that includes all the ingredients.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Do I need to bring anything?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Just an apron. We provide the knives and the other equipment.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: And where is the first class held?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: In the main kitchen on the second floor. Please arrive fifteen minutes early for the first session.

items.stem: Gardeners can borrow seeds from a community seed library without paying.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài nói người làm vườn mượn hạt miễn phí vào đầu mùa trồng.
explanation.whyWrong: Không phải NOT GIVEN vì bài nói rõ việc mượn hạt là miễn phí.
explanation.trap: Cụm 'for free' đổi thành 'without paying' là paraphrase.

evidence.quote: Community seed libraries allow gardeners to borrow seeds for free at the start of the growing season.

items.stem: Members must return exactly the same seeds that they borrowed.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài nói hội viên trả lại một phần hạt mới thu được, không phải chính hạt đã mượn.
explanation.whyWrong: Câu hỏi khẳng định điều ngược với bài nên là FALSE, không phải NOT GIVEN.
explanation.trap: Động từ 'return' có thật trong bài nhưng vật được trả lại khác hẳn.

evidence.quote: They then return some of the new seeds to the library, so that the collection keeps growing year after year.

items.stem: Seed libraries are more common in small towns than in large cities.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài không so sánh mức phổ biến giữa thị trấn nhỏ và thành phố lớn.
explanation.trap: Câu so sánh hơn cần cả hai vế trong bài; ở đây thiếu cả hai.
